examples.question_text:
The sample space is $\xi=\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9\}$, with $A=\{2,4,6,8\}$ and $B=\{1,4,7,8\}$.
List:
a. $A\cap B$
b. $A\cup B$
c. $A'$
d. $A'\cap B$
e. $(A\cup B)'$
examples.solution_text:
a. Keep the elements in both sets.
$A\cap B=\{4,8\}$

b. Combine the elements of both sets, listing each once.
$A\cup B=\{1,2,4,6,7,8\}$

c. Keep the elements of the sample space outside $A$.
$A'=\{1,3,5,7,9\}$

d. From $B$, keep only the elements outside $A$.
$A'\cap B=\{1,7\}$

e. Keep the elements outside both sets.
$(A\cup B)'=\{3,5,9\}$

examples.question_text:
$R$ is the set of students in the reading club and $D$ is the set of students in the drama club.
Describe:
a. $R\cap D$
b. $R\cup D$
c. $R'$
d. $R\cap D'$
e. $R'\cap D'$
examples.solution_text:
a. Intersection means both: students in both the reading club and the drama club.

b. Union includes either set and their overlap: students in the reading club or the drama club, or both.

c. Complement means outside the set: students who are not in the reading club.

d. Keep students inside $R$ and outside $D$: students in the reading club who are not in the drama club.

e. Keep students outside both sets: students in neither the reading club nor the drama club.

Two workshops run at the same time, so nobody can attend both. Of $42$ students, $23$ attend pottery and $14$ attend painting.
$P$ is the pottery group and $T$ is the painting group.
How many students are in:
a. $P\cap T$
